proposed_widenings.name: OngoingEffect.choose_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Each time any trigger fires (creature enters area, creature ends turn in area), the caster independently chooses per-creature between two fundamentally different effects: heal_hp or a save_gate. OngoingEffect has no 'caster chooses between N effect branches at trigger resolution time' variant. CastTimeEffectModeChoice in direct phases is a single global pre-cast choice and does not serve this purpose.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can bathe it in one of the lights: Healing Light (regains 4d12 + spellcasting ability modifier HP) or Searing Light (Dexterity saving throw, 6d12 Radiant damage on failed save or half on success)

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingTrigger.on_caster_moves
proposed_widenings.justification: The cylinder repositions 'when you move on your turn' — it fires as part of the caster's movement, not at turn start and not by spending an action. OngoingTrigger has on_caster_turn_start (unconditional) and on_caster_spends_action (requires consuming an action/bonus-action quota), but no trigger that fires when the caster uses movement specifically.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you move on your turn, you can also move the Cylinder up to 30 feet

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.usageLimit per target per turn
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell constrains that each creature can be affected only once per turn, regardless of how many times the area triggers. No surface field exists to express a per-target-per-turn frequency cap on an ongoing operation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature can be affected by this spell only once per turn.

notes: Family is clearly ongoing_effect with an area (cylinder) attachment. Most atoms exist: emit_light for bright light, reposition_attachment for cylinder movement, on_creature_enters_area and on_attached_turn_start triggers, heal_hp and the OngoingEffect save_gate variant. The hard blocker is that OngoingEffect has no per-trigger caster-choice-between-branches variant. Without it any encoding would apply both effects or arbitrarily choose one — both dishonest. The cylinder-movement trigger is a secondary blocker (on_caster_moves is missing). The upcast (+1d12 healing and damage per slot above 7) would encode cleanly via linear_per_level with axis=slot on both DiceAmounts.
